dedupe_keys.name: seznam javno dostopnih wifi tock v mestni obcini novo mesto

description: Seznam javno dostopnih WiFi točk v Mestni občini Novo mesto is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA NOVO MESTO. List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Novo mesto. The database contains the point name, location coordinate (GMAPS - WGS84), transmission speed (Mbit/s) and provider. Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA NOVO MESTO. The portal shows the English title as "List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Novo mesto" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA NOVO MESTO. Its keywords include dostopne točke, Wi-Fi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
